caseName: In re Disbarment of Van Rye
caseNameFull: In re Disbarment of Van Rye

opinions.text: It is ordered that Kenneth Van Rye, of Elmwood Park, N. J., be suspended from the practice of law in this Court and that a rule issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
